北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京天气晴朗，体感稍凉，记得添衣保暖，注意补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels chilly. Remember to dress warmly and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感微凉。外出记得带件外套，小心着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and feels a bit cool. Bring a jacket when you go out to avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感偏凉。别忘了添件衣服，保持温暖舒适。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels cool. Don't forget to add a layer to stay warm and comfortable.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，气温适中但湿度高。记得多喝水，保持清爽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, warm but humid. Remember to drink more water and stay refreshed.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，天气暖和但湿度大。补水很重要，保持好心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy, warm and humid. Hydration is key, keep a good mood!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有霾，气温偏凉。外出请戴口罩，注意保暖防霾。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is hazy and cool. Please wear a mask when going out and stay warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有霾，体感凉意浓。出门记得戴好口罩，注意防护。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is hazy and feels quite cool. Remember to wear a mask when going out and protect yourself.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，气温舒适。早晚温差大，别忘了适时添减衣物。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is partly cloudy with comfortable temperatures. Mind the big temperature difference between morning and evening, dress accordingly.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉小雨，气温微凉。出门带伞，注意防潮保暖哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has light rain and feels a bit cool. Bring an umbrella, stay dry and warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，气温适中但特别干燥。请多喝水，注意皮肤保湿。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, moderate but extremely dry. Please drink plenty of water and moisturize your skin.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感湿凉。穿衣注意保暖，避免受潮感冒。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels damp and cool. Dress warmly to avoid getting cold from the humidity.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感很冷！风力较大，请务必多穿衣物保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is partly cloudy and feels very cold! It's quite windy, please make sure to dress warmly.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感偏凉。虽有阳光，也要记得添衣防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels cool. Even with sunshine, remember to add layers to keep warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感微凉。早晚温差大，注意适时增减衣物。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny but feels a bit cool. With a big temperature difference between morning and evening, remember to adjust your clothing.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，气温湿度适中。出行注意防雨，保持好心情！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with moderate temperature and humidity. Mind any potential rain when going out and stay cheerful!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感较冷。风力不小，请戴口罩多穿保暖衣物。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is hazy and feels quite cold. It's windy, so please wear a mask and warm clothes.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感较凉。阳光虽好，也要记得添衣防寒哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny but feels cool. Despite the sunshine, remember to add layers to keep warm.
